referenceFunction.generalComment:
This dataset represents the supply of 1 kilogram of methanol. The fuel is distributed by truck over 250 km from regional storage. The methanol is produced by Electrolysis, PEM, with electricity from grid as feedstock. Distribution loss [% output]: 0%. Regional storage loss [% output]: 0. For more information, refer to: Sacchi, R. and Bauer, C. LCA of Power-to-X processes and applications in the residential sector. Paul Scherrer Institut, 2023. Source: Sacchi, R. and Bauer, C. LCA of Power-to-X processes and applications in the residential sector. Paul Scherrer Institut, 2023.
